Woman Attempts Suicide in Canal, Retired Soldier Fires Gun in Separate Incident

In Faridabad, a young woman attempted to jump into a canal after an argument with her boyfriend, but was dissuaded by police. In a separate incident, a retired soldier fired shots after a dispute over water spilling onto a woman, which also involved an assault on a couple.
